name: Yamaha QT50 Yamahopper
engine: 49 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, oil injection, automatic
intro: Yamaha's little step-through moped. Two-stroke, oil injection and a one-speed automatic.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
